rationale: The 24-game pilot offered only six natural games per update and showed no established strength gain. The four-checkpoint development panel was 5-11, 10-6, 8-8, 6-10: no monotonic gain; the intermediate lead is exploratory. Increase on-policy batch game diversity to reduce update sampling noise, while retaining verified objective, network, masks, optimizer, helpers and PPO settings. More data may still fail; fresh gameplay decides.

priorArt.use: PPO reuses on-policy batches with clipped updates; existing implementation retained
stage-specific card-game policies and large training/evaluation regimes; no claim its mechanics or results transfer

initialization.name: first-baseline
initialization.optimizer: preserve exact checkpoint optimizer/update23; no reset

controlledChange: 64 natural complete games per collection/update batch instead of6; six-hour resource allocation permits repeated batches. This tests the full larger-data continuation recipe, not an isolated causal claim about every difference from the historical pilot.
routing: unchanged existing collector ordinary+mandatory-singleton PPO; optional/multi-card selector and native helper frozen
history: existing collector visibleContext semantics retained; final eval uses complete-game AgentBundle in frozen environmentV1. Attribute this train/eval adapter difference explicitly, do not silently rewrite either.

training.opponents: 32 frozen first-baseline and 32 existing AgentPult teacher games per batch, 16 per seat per opponent; mirrored retained Hammerpult recipe
training.expectedThroughput: Historical 24-game pilot took 858.827 seconds at two lanes (~101 natural games/hour). Four-lane sustained throughput must be measured; no assumed 2x speedup. The six-hour campaign reports actual completed games, batches and optimizer steps.
training.admission: fit only all64natural accepted episodes with no errors/exclusions/rejections and <=16384total records; no reward for incomplete or failed games
training.checkpointRule: last fully admitted, immutable, reload-verified update completed before10:00Z; no outcome-based checkpoint selection
training.stopping: fixed absolute deadline; validity/resource failure may stop training and must retain all partial evidence; preserve last verified checkpoint. Never start a competing trained candidate.
training.engine: pin before launch; use qualified speed gain only with explicit differential evidence and source identity; do not wait past start for infrastructure or change a running comparison
training.recovery: On a batch with any excluded/time-limited/fatal game, discard the entire batch from gradients, retain all raw evidence, and advance to the next predeclared64-game batch with the SAME last valid parent; do not refill based on outcomes. Source/hash/privacy mismatch fails closed. No partial fits, second trajectory, seed reuse or deadline extension. Any skipped batches and resulting training-distribution limitation are reported.

monitoring.snapshotRule: last completed immutable checkpoint at each nominal time; asynchronous evaluation never reads mutable trainer weights
monitoring.question: detect very large30percentage-point gain or collapse relative to parity; no claim this panel resolves10point shifts
monitoring.interval: two-sided97.5% Hoeffding perpoint; Bonferroni simultaneous95% over two planned points

strengthPlan.effect: 10 percentage points in candidate game score above parity (0.60 versus 0.50)
strengthPlan.independentUnit: independent uniformly sampled uint32 seed block; both candidate seats averaged within each block
strengthPlan.uncertainty: fixed-endpoint two-sided 95% Hoeffding interval over 512 bounded paired means; no stopping on observed wins

sampleJustification.assumptions: independent seed blocks; pair scores bounded in [0,1]; no independence assumed between seats
sampleJustification.selectionMultiplicity: one preselected final candidate and one fresh comparison; development outcomes never pooled

strengthPlan.decision: lower bound >0.50 demonstrates scenario-specific improvement; upper bound <0.60 rules out the targeted 10-point gain; otherwise unresolved. Preserve baseline until separately reviewed promotion.
strengthPlan.scope: fixed native scenario, not a claim of strength across all decks or official-client play
strengthPlan.failureContract: unchanged: policy forfeit, command cap draw, shared harness failure stops and invalidates incomplete confirmation
strengthPlan.stopping: all 512 pairs at fixed endpoint; operational wall cap 8h, no statistical claim if incomplete
strengthPlan.resources: six CPU lanes after a separate capacity check; same single-thread model servers, no paid infrastructure; actual cost recorded

seedAudit.method: crypto.randomBytes uint32 sampling without replacement; excluded all 5-10 digit integers from existing local run/repro JSON and available pilot receipt

publicPreservation: source/config/seeds/hash/results versioned; private weights,rawrecords,journals and input paths external
limitations: Whole-batch exclusion can correlate with policy behavior, game length or failure frequency and therefore select the training distribution. The retained data must not be described as an unbiased sample of all attempted play. Report attempted/admitted/discarded games and decisions by failure reason, opponent, seat, batch and parent checkpoint.

Discarding an affected batch can waste valid trajectories. This is a declared conservative reuse of the existing admission path, not proof that every discarded trajectory was unusable. No failure reward is invented and exclusions cannot establish an algorithm no-effect claim.
Existing ordinary/singleton learning leaves optional/multi-card selector/helper decisions frozen; this measures the chosen continuation rather than isolating that ceiling.
Final evidence is scenario-specific. Train/eval history adapter difference is explicit and broader-deck/client strength remains unmeasured.

externalReuseDecision.decision: Retain the prepared categorical PPO training path for this one overnight run; pursue a separate source-only adaptation without an extra trained candidate.
externalReuseDecision.evidence: The checked-in Python code is inference/search, with no optimizer or PPO training pipeline. CABT-specific action enumeration and hidden allocation require correction before trustworthy native search targets. Reusing search decisions with pre-search actor log probabilities would not supply correct on-policy behavior ratios.
externalReuseDecision.licenseScope: MIT source is available for attributed adaptation. Supplied competition-trained weights are not cleared for this independent ladder; separate owner is recording applicable terms.
externalReuseDecision.remainingOpportunity: Native search-target distillation or sparse scoring can be evaluated separately after the adapter is verified; do not silently combine it with this controlled continuation.
